answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fakes. An agent locks 120 coins, twice its 30-day earnings. It decays 5% per epoch, reaching its nadir, zero, after 20 epochs unless renewed by verified work in a public atlas, such as identifying a lotus in an image. Making 1000 fakes costs 120000 coins plus renewals. An honest agent pays once, renews by real work, and keeps undiluted rewards, while a bought bond lapses since renewal checks original work.
